{{Quote|I was there at the Sacking of Coruscant. Do you know how many civilians died in the bombings alone?|Zale Burrows to the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] sent to find him|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zale Barrows''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] who was active during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
He participated in the [[Battle on the Hydian Way|attack]] on the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]] in [[3660 BBY]] and later led the freelancer [[Free Spacers Fleet]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in battles at [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Barrows accepted a job from the Republic as ferryman to the hidden prison [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].

{{GameDS}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was hunted by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] agent of [[Darth Tormen]]. While on the run from the Hunter and [[Skadge]], a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] inmate whom Zale personally imprisoned, Zale journeyed into [[The Tomb]] to prevent Operations Group One from freeing its prisoners. Cornered by the Hunter and Skadge, he attempted to bargain to be allowed to stop the Imperials but the Hunter refused, having to let Skadge take his revenge by killing him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Fate===
After defeating Zale, the player can choose whether to allow Skadge to beat him to death (dark side dialogue) or void their agreement and freeze Zale in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].
